# Red Mountain Photography

> Architectural, interior and real estate photography and property video by Tim Barber. Based in Telluride, Colorado. Works across the Colorado high country (Telluride, Mountain Village, Ridgway, Ouray, Aspen, Vail and beyond) and travels nationwide.

Red Mountain Photography is the architecture and real estate studio of Red Mountain Media. Clients are architects, builders, interior designers, real estate brokers and hospitality brands. Projects are quoted individually: listings by bedroom count, architectural and partial shoots by number of spaces. Listing shoots are delivered within three business days; architectural and design work in about two weeks. Aerial work is flown by an FAA-certified pilot.

Contact: tim@redmountainphotos.com, (970) 670-0846. Quote requests: https://redmountainphotos.com/contact
